notes.title: Sales have exceeded 200,Translating into English is on the agenda!
notes.content:
Many players have been asking why they can't deal with Wang'an (that very bad eunuch ghost). The feedback has been extremely strong, so we've decided to figure something out. For future updates, we want to hear your opinions! Please feel free to leave your suggestions below this announcement！

Here are the updates scheduled:

1.Finding a way to deal with Wang'an -> Must involve gameplay, not just simple achievements, plot points, or CG.
2.English localization -> Welcome foreign friends to play our game!
